sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hello, doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 你好,医生.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Hello, please take a seat.
sentences.translationZh: 你好 请坐.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: I have your test results here, and it's good news.
sentences.translationZh: 我这里有你的测试结果 这是好消息.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: The blood test came back clear.
sentences.translationZh: 血检结果出来了.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: There is no indication of any digestive issues.
sentences.translationZh: 没有任何消化问题的迹象.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: So then why do I feel so poorly all the time?
sentences.translationZh: 那为什么我总是觉得很不好?

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: It's probably due to overwork and stress.
sentences.translationZh: 这可能是由于过度劳累和压力.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: No, it can't be.
sentences.translationZh: 不,这不可能.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I've always been working hard, but I've never felt stress.
sentences.translationZh: 我一直很努力工作,但从未感受到过压力.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Other people suffering complain about that, but I don't.
sentences.translationZh: 受苦受难的其他人对此提出抱怨,但是我没有.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It must be something else.
sentences.translationZh: 一定是别的东西.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: What you have just described is a common sentiment.
sentences.translationZh: 你刚才描述的是一种共同的情绪.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Many people who suffer from stress fail to recognise it.
sentences.translationZh: 许多人因压力而得不到承认.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You told me you often work long into the night, right?
sentences.translationZh: 你告诉我你经常在夜里工作,对吧?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yes, most days in fact.
sentences.translationZh: 是的,事实上大部分时间.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: But I've been doing that for about 20 years now.
sentences.translationZh: 但我已经做了大约20年了.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: That doesn't matter.
sentences.translationZh: 这不重要.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You could have been suffering from stress for 20 years without knowing it, and now it's catching up to you.
sentences.translationZh: 你可能已经承受了20年的压力 而现在它正在追上你.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: But what about my feeling tired all the time and not being able to sleep well at night?
sentences.translationZh: 我总是觉得累了 晚上睡不着?

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Those are common consequences of stress.
sentences.translationZh: 这些是压力的共同后果.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: And if you don't sleep well, then of course you will feel fatigued.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你睡得不好 那你当然会感到疲惫.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: I'm going to prescribe some special sleeping pills for you.
sentences.translationZh: 我会给你开一些特殊的安眠药.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: They have a soft, gentle effect and are made from natural ingredients, so your stomach should tolerate them fine, and there shouldn't be any negative side effects.
sentences.translationZh: 它们具有柔和而温和的效果,由天然成份所制成,所以你的胃应该能忍受它们,不应该有任何负面的副作用.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Take one with your dinner and come see me after a month.
sentences.translationZh: 吃一顿晚饭 一个月后来找我.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: If there is no improvement, I'll give you something stronger.
sentences.translationZh: 如果没有改善,我会给你更强一些的东西.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Thank you, doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 谢谢你,医生.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: That's not all.
sentences.translationZh: 还没完呢.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You should try and work less.
sentences.translationZh: 你应该尽量少工作.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Is there any way you can decrease your workload?
sentences.translationZh: 你能减轻你的工作量吗?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Um, I'd have to think about it.
sentences.translationZh: 嗯,我得考虑一下.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I'm a restaurant manager and this industry is very competitive.
sentences.translationZh: 我是个餐馆经理 这个行业很有竞争力.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: There are many things to keep track of and stay on top of.
sentences.translationZh: 有许多事情需要跟踪和保持上面.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: I recommend you think about delegating some responsibilities to someone else.
sentences.translationZh: 我建议你考虑把一些责任交给别人.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: I'm not asking you to retire.
sentences.translationZh: 我不是让你退休的.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Just to slow down a bit.
sentences.translationZh: 只是想慢点.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: It's for your own health.
sentences.translationZh: 这是为了你自己的健康.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Today on People in the News, our guest is John Williams.
sentences.translationZh: 今天在《大众新闻》上 我们的客人是约翰·威廉姆斯.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: The name may not sound familiar to you, but John was once an acclaimed basketball player.
sentences.translationZh: 这个名字对你来说可能并不熟悉,但约翰曾经是一位被誉为篮球运动员.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: John, you stunned fans by leaving the sport at just 25.
sentences.translationZh: 约翰,你离开球队25岁就吓倒球迷了.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Why did you retire so early?
sentences.translationZh: 你为什么这么早退休?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Meg, I loved being an athlete, but I didn't love being a celebrity.
sentences.translationZh: 梅格,我喜欢当运动员 但我不喜欢当名人.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I was in the limelight when I was still a high school student and went professional right after high school graduation, which was a mistake.
sentences.translationZh: 中学毕业后,我仍然在关注焦点,在高中毕业后立即走上专业,这是错误的.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I was a shy kid and I wasn't ready for all the media attention.
sentences.translationZh: 我是一个害羞的孩子 我还没有准备好 所有媒体的关注.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: But walking away from millions of dollars at the height of your career, most people wouldn't be able to resist the lure of such a high salary.
sentences.translationZh: 但是,在你事业的巅峰时期,离开数百万美元,大多数人是无法抗拒如此高薪的诱惑的.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: When you left the sport, there was speculation that you were having issues with your teammates or even an injury.
sentences.translationZh: 离开运动时,有人猜测你和队友有矛盾甚至受伤.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Not at all.
sentences.translationZh: 一点也不.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It was hard to quit.
sentences.translationZh: 这很难退出.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I was tempted to stay in the game, because I love basketball and I loved my team.
sentences.translationZh: 我本想留在比赛中 因为我喜欢篮球 我爱我的球队.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: As for money, I turned professional at 18.
sentences.translationZh: 至于钱,我18岁就成了专业的.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: So I'd actually earned a lot and saved most of it, because I had great financial advisers.
sentences.translationZh: 所以我赚了很多钱,节省了大部分, 因为我有很好的财务顾问.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I knew basketball wasn't a career with a lot of longevity for most players, so I wanted to change careers while I was still young.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道篮球对于大多数球员来说并不是一个长生不老的事业,所以我想趁我还年轻的时候改变事业.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Okay, that was 20 years ago, and you're back in the news.
sentences.translationZh: 好吧,那是20年前,你又回到新闻.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You've created a foundation that works to get more kids playing team sports.
sentences.translationZh: 你创造了一个基金会, 致力于让更多的孩子 玩团队运动.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Why?
sentences.translationZh: 为什么？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I went to university and I studied public health and learned about the seriousness of the obesity epidemic, particularly among kids and adolescents in poor communities.
sentences.translationZh: 我上大学,学习公共卫生,了解了肥胖流行的严重性,特别是在贫困社区的儿童和青少年中.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I've spent the last two decades trying to alleviate the problem.
sentences.translationZh: 过去20年我一直在努力缓解这个问题.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: The foundation is just the latest attempt.
sentences.translationZh: 基金会只是最新的尝试.

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: The foundation uses private donations to support basketball teams for girls and boys in primary school, right?
sentences.translationZh: 基金会利用私人捐款支持小学男女篮球队,对吗?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Actually, we support teams for secondary school students, too, and also have some public funding.
sentences.translationZh: 实际上,我们也支持中学生团队,并有一些公共资金.

sentences.text: Kate Atkinson was born in York, England, in 1951.
sentences.translationZh: 凯特·阿特金森于1951年生于英国约克.

sentences.text: She worked hard to gain her credentials as an author.
sentences.translationZh: 她为获得作者资格而努力工作.

sentences.text: She studied English Literature at University in Scotland.
sentences.translationZh: 她在苏格兰大学学习英语文学.

sentences.text: After graduating in 1974, she researched a doctorate on American Literature.
sentences.translationZh: 1974年毕业后她研究了美国文学博士学位.

sentences.text: Later, she taught at the university she graduated from, and began writing short stories in 1981.
sentences.translationZh: 后来她任教于她毕业的大学,1981年开始写短篇故事.

sentences.text: She began writing for women's magazines after winning the 1986 Woman's Own Short Story Competition.
sentences.translationZh: 她在1986年"女人自有短篇小说"比赛中获胜后开始为女性杂志作曲.

sentences.text: Her first novel, Behind the Scenes at the Museum, won the 1995 UK Book of the Year award.
sentences.translationZh: 她的第一部小说"博物馆幕后"(Behind the Scenes at the Museum)获得了1995年英国"年度书"奖.

sentences.text: The book is set in Yorkshire and has been adapted for radio, theatre, and TV.
sentences.translationZh: 该书被设定在约克郡并被改编为广播,戏剧,电视.

sentences.text: She has written two plays for a theatre in Edinburgh — the first was called Nice and the second Abandonment, performed as part of the Edinburgh Festival in August 2000.
sentences.translationZh: 她为爱丁堡的一个剧院写了两出戏剧——第一部被称作"尼斯"(Nice),第二部被抛弃,作为2000年8月爱丁堡节的一部分演出.

sentences.text: Whatever genre Atkinson writes in, her books touch on the themes of love and loss and how to carry on.
sentences.translationZh: 无论阿特金森的流派写作,她所著的书触及了爱情和损失的主题以及如何继续.

sentences.text: They are always presented with ingenuity and a wicked sense of humor.
sentences.translationZh: 他们总是有才智和邪恶的幽默感.

sentences.text: Her books tend to be populated by odd, sometimes sinful, and generally flawed eccentrics who become credible by virtue of being so fully realized.
sentences.translationZh: 她的书中往往有奇特的,有时是罪恶的,一般有缺陷的怪人,他们因为如此被充分认识而变得可信.

sentences.text: Her books have frequently been described as comedies of manners.
sentences.translationZh: 她的书经常被描述为有礼貌的喜剧.

sentences.text: That is to say, comedies that represent the complex and sophisticated code of behaviour current in fashionable circles of society, where appearances count more than true moral character.
sentences.translationZh: 也就是说,喜剧代表了时尚社会圈子里现在的复杂而复杂的行为准则,其外表比真正的道德品德更重要.

sentences.text: A comedy of manners tends to reward its clever and deceitful characters, rather than punish their bad deeds.
sentences.translationZh: 一种举止出众的喜剧往往会奖励其巧妙而欺骗的人物,而不是惩罚他们的恶行.

sentences.text: The humor of a comedy of manners relies on verbal wit and playful teasing.
sentences.translationZh: 喜剧"礼貌"的幽默感依赖于口才和玩弄取笑.

sentences.text: Why is adaptability an important skill to exercise in the workplace?
sentences.translationZh: 为什么适应能力是工作场所锻炼的重要技能?

sentences.text: Simply put, adaptability is a skill employers are increasingly looking for.
sentences.translationZh: 简言之,适应性是雇主日益寻求的一种技能.

sentences.text: When you spend time learning a new task rather than resisting it, your productivity goes up.
sentences.translationZh: 当你花时间学习新的任务 而不是抗拒它, 你的生产力上升.

sentences.text: You can also serve as an example to your co-workers who may be having trouble adapting, and can help lead your team forward.
sentences.translationZh: 你也可以作为你同事的榜样,他们可能难以适应,可以帮助带领你的团队前进.

sentences.text: Strategy consultant, Dorie Clark, explains it to us this way.
sentences.translationZh: 战略顾问多莉・克拉克 用这种方式向我们解释.

sentences.text: "I'd say that adaptability is an important skill in the workplace because frankly, circumstances change.
sentences.translationZh: "我可以说适应性是工作场所的重要技能,因为坦率地说,情况会改变.

sentences.text: Competitors introduce new products, economy might enter a recession, customer preferences differ over time, and more.
sentences.translationZh: 竞争者引进了新产品,经济可能陷入衰退,客户的偏好随时间而异,甚至更多.

sentences.text: If you shake your fist at the sky and say why can't it stay the same, that's not going to do very much good.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你在天上摇起拳头,说为什么它不能保持不变,那就没有什么好处了.

sentences.text: Instead, you need to recognise when circumstances have changed, so you can take appropriate action based on what is, rather than how you wish the world would be.
sentences.translationZh: 相反,你需要认识到情况已经改变,以便你能够根据情况采取适当行动,而不是希望世界会怎样.

sentences.text: That enables you to make more accurate, informed and effective choices."
sentences.translationZh: 这使得你能够做出更加准确,知情和有效的选择"

sentences.text: Also, the workplace itself has been evolving.
sentences.translationZh: 此外,工作场所本身也在不断发展.

sentences.text: Today's work culture and management style is often based on teamwork, rather than a rigid hierarchy.
sentences.translationZh: 今天的工作文化和管理风格往往基于团队精神,而不是僵硬的等级制度.

sentences.text: Brainstorming, which requires creativity, flexibility, and emotional intelligence, is a typical problem-solving technique.
sentences.translationZh: 集思广益需要创造力,灵活性和情感智能,是典型的解决问题技术.

sentences.text: Employees who are unable or unwilling to participate will not easily move forward in the company.
sentences.translationZh: 无法或不愿参与的雇员不会轻易在公司中前进.

sentences.text: Employees who are flexible demonstrate other skills too.
sentences.translationZh: 灵活行事的雇员也表现出其他技能.

sentences.text: They can reprioritize quickly when changes occur and suggest additional modifications when something is not working.
sentences.translationZh: 当变化发生时,它们可以迅速重新排列优先顺序,当某事不起作用时,它们可以提出额外的修改建议.

sentences.text: They can also regroup quickly when a setback occurs, adapting to the new situation confidently and without overreacting.
sentences.translationZh: 当出现挫折时,它们也可以迅速重新组合,自信地适应新的局势,而不会过度反应.

sentences.text: What makes humans different from other species?
sentences.translationZh: 是什么使人类与其他物种不同?

sentences.text: Some philosophers argue it's morals or ethics, while some scientists assert it's our greater cognitive development.
sentences.translationZh: 一些哲学家认为这是道德或伦理,而一些科学家则断言这是我们更大的认知发展.

sentences.text: But I argue that the main difference is our desire to combat routine.
sentences.translationZh: 但我认为,主要的区别在于我们想要打击常规.

sentences.text: This makes being creative a biological mandate, as what we seek in art and technology is surprise, not simply a fulfillment of expectations.
sentences.translationZh: 这使创造性成为一项生物任务,因为我们在艺术和技术方面寻求的是出人意料的,而不仅仅是实现期望.

sentences.text: As a result, a wild imagination has characterized the history of our species.
sentences.translationZh: 因此,我们物种的历史呈现出一种野生的想象力.

sentences.text: We build intricate habitats, devise complex recipes for our food, wear clothes that reflect constant changes in fashion, communicate with elaborate signs, symbols, and sounds, and travel between habitats on wings and wheels of our own design.
sentences.translationZh: 我们建造复杂的栖息地, 为我们的食物设计复杂的食谱, 穿戴能够反映时尚变化的服饰, 与精心的标志,符号,和声音进行交流, 在栖息地之间穿梭于我们自己设计的翅膀和轮子上.

sentences.text: To satisfy our appetite for novelty, innovation is key.
sentences.translationZh: 为了满足我们对创新的胃口,创新是关键.

sentences.text: But who innovates?
sentences.translationZh: 但谁创新?

sentences.text: Now, many people, both laymen and experts, believe that only geniuses innovate.
sentences.translationZh: 现在,许多人,无论是外行还是专家,都认为只有天才才有创新.

sentences.text: But I believe that innovation is not something that only a few people do.
sentences.translationZh: 但我相信,创新不是只有少数人做的.

sentences.text: The innovative drive lives in every human brain, and the resulting war against the repetitive is what powers the massive changes that distinguish one generation from the next.
sentences.translationZh: 创新的驱动力生活在每一个人类的大脑中,由此产生的与重复性相抗衡的战争,就是将一代人和下一代人区别开来的巨大变化的力量.

sentences.text: The drive to create the new is a trait of being human.
sentences.translationZh: 创造新的动力是人类的特质.

sentences.text: We build cultures by the hundreds and tell new stories by the millions.
sentences.translationZh: 我们用上百人创造文化,用上百万人讲述新的故事.

sentences.text: We create and surround ourselves with things that have never existed before, while animals do not.
sentences.translationZh: 我们创造和包围着我们自己 以前所未有的东西, 而动物没有.

sentences.text: But where do our new ideas come from?
sentences.translationZh: 但我们的新想法从何而来?

sentences.text: According to many, new ideas come from seemingly nowhere to great minds.
sentences.translationZh: 许多人认为,新思想似乎从无地到伟大的思想.

sentences.text: From this perspective, new ideas are almost like magic.
sentences.translationZh: 从这个角度看,新思想几乎像魔法一样.

sentences.text: They come in a flash of inspiration to a select few.
sentences.translationZh: 他们一闪一闪的灵感 给少数选取.

sentences.text: However, the reality is that, across the spectrum of human activities, prior work propels the creative process.
sentences.translationZh: 然而,现实情况是,在人类活动的方方面面,以前的工作推动了创造性进程.

sentences.text: We may think of innovation as being the result of inspiration or genius, but it's really the result of developing the ideas of others further.
sentences.translationZh: 我们也许认为创新是灵感或才智的结果,但这确实是进一步开发他人思想的结果.

sentences.text: This happens in technology, where one invention enables or inspires further inventions.
sentences.translationZh: 这发生在技术领域,一种发明能够或激励进一步发明.

sentences.text: And it happens in the arts, as writers, composers, and painters use the work of previous artists in their own work.
sentences.translationZh: 而它也发生在艺术中,因为作家,作曲家,和画家在自己的作品中使用了前作艺术家的作品.

sentences.text: The human brain works from precedent.
sentences.translationZh: 人脑从先例而出.

sentences.text: We take the ideas we've inherited and put them together into some new shape.
sentences.translationZh: 我们用我们继承的理念,把它们组合成新的形态.

sentences.text: What is a true creator?
sentences.translationZh: 什么是真正的创造者?

sentences.text: Is a creator a genius who makes something out of nothing?
sentences.translationZh: 一个创造者是个天才,他无所事事?

sentences.text: No. Creators are simply humans who use what they inherit, who absorb the past and manipulate it to create possible futures.
sentences.translationZh: 没有 造物主只是人类,他们使用他们继承的东西,吸收了过去,并操纵它来创造可能的未来.

sentences.text: Thus, humans are creators as a rule rather than as an exception.
sentences.translationZh: 因此,人类通常是创造者,而不是例外.

sentences.text: Many dog owners would tell you that their dog somehow knows when they're ill or upset, and according to researchers who study dog cognition, those pet owners are right.
sentences.translationZh: 许多狗主会告诉你 他们的狗不知何故知道 当他们生病或心烦意乱, 根据研究狗认知的研究人员, 那些宠物主是正确的.

sentences.text: Dogs do know when their human companions are having a rough time.
sentences.translationZh: 狗们知道它们的人类同伴 什么时候过得很艰难.

sentences.text: Not only can your dog sense when you have a cold, but domestic dogs have shown an aptitude for detecting both much smaller mood fluctuations and far more serious physical conditions.
sentences.translationZh: 不仅你的狗在感冒时能感觉到, 而且家犬也显示出了 探测更小的情绪波动 和更严重的身体条件的能力.

sentences.text: This is because dogs are extremely sensitive to changes in the people they're familiar with, and illness causes change.
sentences.translationZh: 这是因为狗对所熟悉的人的变化极为敏感,而疾病导致变化.

sentences.text: If a person is infected with a virus or bacteria, for example, their odor will be abnormal, and dogs are able to smell that change even if the human can't, because dogs have a much more powerful sense of smell than humans.
sentences.translationZh: 例如,如果一个人感染了病毒或细菌,他们的气味就会异常,而狗即使人类不能闻到这种变化,因为狗的嗅觉比人类强得多.

sentences.text: Researchers have also found that a person's mood, which can be an indicator of a larger illness, triggers a dog's sense of smell.
sentences.translationZh: 研究者还发现,一个人的情绪,可以作为较大疾病的指标,会触发狗的嗅觉.

sentences.text: Human emotions manifest physically in chemical signals that are emitted by the body, and dogs are able to smell those as well.
sentences.translationZh: 人类的情绪在身体释放的化学信号中表现出来,而狗也能闻到这些.

sentences.text: Beyond smell, dogs gather information from a person's voice in order to sense changes.
sentences.translationZh: 在嗅觉之外,狗从一个人的声音中收集信息,以感知变化.

sentences.text: In 2014, researchers discovered that dogs have an area of the brain similar to one in humans that allows them to understand emotional cues in the tone of a speaker's voice, beyond what they'd be able to pick up from familiar words alone.
sentences.translationZh: 2014年,研究者发现狗脑有一个类似于人类大脑的区域,使得它们能够用扬声器的基调来理解情绪提示,超越了它们单独从熟悉的文字中能够取出的东西.

sentences.text: A person's voice can also carry indicators of illness.
sentences.translationZh: 一个人的声音也可以携带疾病的指标.

sentences.text: What's not understood quite so well is what dogs understand about these changes.
sentences.translationZh: 不太清楚的是狗对这些变化的理解.

sentences.text: Humans send out lots of cues, but whether dogs know some of these cues mean illness isn't clear.
sentences.translationZh: 人类发出许多提示, 但狗是否知道一些这些提示意味着疾病是不清楚的.

sentences.text: What we perceive as concern on a dog's part might be more like increased curiosity or suspicion that something is wrong with us, and sticking close by is a great way to gather more information about the situation.
sentences.translationZh: 我们所认为的对狗的关心,可能更像是增加好奇心或怀疑我们有什么不对劲,而坚持靠拢是收集更多有关局势的信息的好办法.

sentences.text: Some researchers assert dogs will one day help doctors diagnose diseases, as some dogs have already demonstrated the ability to detect an assortment of ailments, including diabetes and certain types of cancer.
sentences.translationZh: 一些研究者断言有朝一日狗会帮助医生诊断出疾病,因为有的狗已经证明有能力检测出各种疾病,包括糖尿病和某些类型的癌症.

sentences.text: But those researchers concede that's probably in the distant future.
sentences.translationZh: 但是那些研究者承认 这可能是在遥远的未来.

sentences.text: For now, research suggests dog ownership can have an array of benefits in and of itself.
sentences.translationZh: 目前,研究表明狗的所有权本身可以产生一系列好处.

sentences.text: Keeping a pet dog has been shown to bolster health and boost mood.
sentences.translationZh: 养一只宠物狗可以增强健康和情绪.

sentences.text: Dogs also help people relax, and they can be a particular comfort to those with chronic diseases.
sentences.translationZh: 狗也帮助人们放松,对有慢性病的人来说,狗可以是一种特殊的安慰.

Britain’s defective educational system

sentences.text: Earlier this month, the think-tank called Onward published a report, "A Question of Degree", which argues that degrees in the creative arts are not good value for money.
sentences.translationZh: 本月早些时候,名为"Onward"的智囊团发表了一份报告"学位问题",该报告认为,创作艺术中的学位不具有良好的金钱价值.

sentences.text: Ministers, according to Onward, should "crack down on courses that offer extremely limited value for money to students ten years after graduation", restricting the ability of such courses to recruit new students, if the average graduate earns below the student loans payment threshold.
sentences.translationZh: 根据Onward的说法,如果平均毕业生收入低于学生贷款支付门槛,部长们应该"在毕业后10年向学生提供极其有限的金钱价值的课程上打压",限制这类课程招聘新生的能力.

sentences.text: Courses like science, technology, engineering, and math, and economics, where the average graduate earns a lot, should be favored.
sentences.translationZh: 科学、技术、工程、数学和经济学等课程,如果平均毕业生收入很高,应该受到青睐.

sentences.text: The report provides insight into a government review which looks at how to reform technical education and how to ensure students get good value for money.
sentences.translationZh: 报告提供了对政府审查的见解,该审查审视了如何改革技术教育以及如何确保学生获得良好的资金价值.

sentences.text: At first glance, it might even seem like Onward have a point.
sentences.translationZh: 乍一看,它甚至可能 看起来像Onward有一点.

sentences.text: According to their data, the majority of creative arts students earn less than 25,000 pounds a year, ten years after graduation.
sentences.translationZh: 根据他们的数据,大多数创意艺术学生在毕业后10年,每年收入不到25,000磅.

sentences.text: The average male creative arts students, indeed, apparently earn much less than they would, had they simply never gone to university.
sentences.translationZh: 事实上,男性创作艺术学生如果从未上过大学,收入显然比他们低得多.

sentences.text: This isn't really good for anyone, and it's certainly no good for graduates, who are forced to endure a lifestyle where they can never save up, never buy a house, never hope to retire.
sentences.translationZh: 这对任何人都不好, 这对毕业生当然也不好, 他们被迫忍受一种生活方式, 他们永远不能储蓄, 永远不能买房子, 永远不能退休.

sentences.text: Onward have identified a real problem.
sentences.translationZh: 接下来,我们发现了一个真正的问题.

sentences.text: Creative arts graduates from top universities — like Oxford, with a high proportion of privately-educated students — have fairly good work prospects.
sentences.translationZh: 来自顶尖大学的创意艺术毕业生——如牛津大学,受过私人教育的学生比例很高——工作前景相当好.

sentences.text: Well, 40 percent of all graduates — regardless of their degree — are on less than 25,000 pounds a year, 5 years after graduation.
sentences.translationZh: 40%的毕业生——无论学位如何—— 在毕业5年后,每年的体重不到25,000磅.

sentences.text: This suggests that the problem isn't really to do with specific students studying specific degrees, but really with the economy as a whole.
sentences.translationZh: 这表明问题并不真正与特定学生学习特定学位有关,而是真正与整个经济有关.

sentences.text: Regardless of what they've studied, young people find it hard to get ahead unless they're lucky enough to be born with successful parents.
sentences.translationZh: 不论他们研究了什么,除非他们幸运地与成功的父母相生,否则年轻人发现很难提前.

sentences.text: If ministers want to make education pay for young people, they need to look beyond the higher education sector, towards the wider world.
sentences.translationZh: 如果部长们想让年轻人获得教育报酬,他们就必须超越高等教育部门,面向更广阔的世界.

sentences.text: The rewards that education gives us are not measurable.
sentences.translationZh: 教育给我们的回报是无法衡量的.

sentences.text: They are not always instantly obvious, and certainly not always direct.
sentences.translationZh: 它们并不总是立即显现的,当然并不总是直接的.

sentences.text: An education makes you a different person from the one you would have been if you hadn't received it.
sentences.translationZh: 教育使你与如果没有接受教育 你本会是不同的人.

sentences.text: We need to look at the value of education not in the context of a bank balance, but of a life.
sentences.translationZh: 我们需要审视教育的价值,不是从银行余额的角度,而是从生活的角度.

sentences.text: If we continue to allow ourselves to be distracted with talk of "value for money", we will all be made poorer as a result.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我们继续让自己被"金钱价值"的说辞所分心,我们就会因此变得更穷.
